properties.name: Hidden Valley sand ripples (estimated zone)
properties.status: ESTIMATE - circle of radius_m around each rover waypoint; real boundary not mapped
properties.evidence: Curiosity entered Hidden Valley ripples sol 706-709 (Aug 2014) and backed out due to high wheel slip (JPL news 'Curiosity Mars rover prepares for fourth rock drilling'; Planetary Society; JGR Planets 2021 2021JGRE..12606904B abstract)
properties.eta_rule: eta = max(eta, 1.5 + 1.3/V^2) at flat speed (Richmond et al. 2015 Table 11, sand)
